children: NRW Holdings' A$960 million, five-year contract extension at the Karara iron ore mine materially improves revenue visibility from FY 2028 onward, says Euroz Hartleys. "The contract win is a welcome expansion and demonstrates the ongoing contract newsflow we expect to continue as operating cadence builds," says the broker. It reiterates a buy rating and A$9.06/share target. The stock is up 4.2% at A$7.88/share. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
